record.bible_text: The LORD<WH03068> shewed<WH07200><WTH8689> me, and, behold, two<WH08147> baskets<WH01736> of figs<WH08384> <FI>were<Fi> set<WH03259><WTH8716> before<WH06440> the temple<WH01964> of the LORD<WH03068>, after<WH0310> that Nebuchadrezzar<WH05019> king<WH04428> of Babylon<WH0894> had carried away captive<WH01540><WTH8687> Jeconiah<WH03204> the son<WH01121> of Jehoiakim<WH03079> king<WH04428> of Judah<WH03063>, and the princes<WH08269> of Judah<WH03063>, with the carpenters<WH02796> and smiths<WH04525>, from Jerusalem<WH03389>, and had brought<WH0935><WTH8686> them to Babylon<WH0894>.

One<WH0259> basket<WH01731> <FI>had<Fi> very<WH03966> good<WH02896> figs<WH08384>, <FI>even<Fi> like the figs<WH08384> <FI>that are<Fi> first ripe<WH01073>: and the other<WH0259> basket<WH01731> <FI>had<Fi> very<WH03966> naughty<WH07451> figs<WH08384>, which could not be eaten<WH0398><WTH8735>, they were so bad<WH07455>. <RF>they...: Heb. for badness<Rf>

Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> the LORD<WH03068> unto me, What seest<WH07200><WTH8802> thou, Jeremiah<WH03414>? And I said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Figs<WH08384>; the good<WH02896> figs<WH08384>, very<WH03966> good<WH02896>; and the evil<WH07451>, very<WH03966> evil<WH07451>, that cannot be eaten<WH0398><WTH8735>, they are so evil<WH07455>.
Again the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came unto me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, the God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>; Like these good<WH02896> figs<WH08384>, so will I acknowledge<WH05234><WTH8686> them that are carried away captive<WH01546> of Judah<WH03063>, whom I have sent<WH07971><WTH8765> out of this place<WH04725> into the land<WH0776> of the Chaldeans<WH03778> for <FI>their<Fi> good<WH02896>. <RF>them...: Heb. the captivity<Rf>

For I will set<WH07760><WTH8804> mine eyes<WH05869> upon them for good<WH02896>, and I will bring them again<WH07725><WTH8689> to this land<WH0776>: and I will build<WH01129><WTH8804> them, and not pull <FI>them<Fi> down<WH02040><WTH8799>; and I will plant<WH05193><WTH8804> them, and not pluck <FI>them<Fi> up<WH05428><WTH8799>.

And I will give<WH05414><WTH8804> them an heart<WH03820> to know<WH03045><WTH8800> me, that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>: and they shall be my people<WH05971>, and I will be their God<WH0430>: for they shall return<WH07725><WTH8799> unto me with their whole heart<WH03820>.

And as the evil<WH07451> figs<WH08384>, which cannot be eaten<WH0398><WTH8735>, they are so evil<WH07455>; surely thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, So will I give<WH05414><WTH8799> Zedekiah<WH06667> the king<WH04428> of Judah<WH03063>, and his princes<WH08269>, and the residue<WH07611> of Jerusalem<WH03389>, that remain<WH07604><WTH8737> in this land<WH0776>, and them that dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> in the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>:

And I will deliver<WH05414><WTH8804> them to be removed<WH02189><WTH8675><WH02113> into all the kingdoms<WH04467> of the earth<WH0776> for <FI>their<Fi> hurt<WH07451>, <FI>to be<Fi> a reproach<WH02781> and a proverb<WH04912>, a taunt<WH08148> and a curse<WH07045>, in all places<WH04725> whither I shall drive<WH05080><WTH8686> them. <RF>to be removed: Heb. for removing, or, vexation<Rf>

And I will send<WH07971><WTH8765> the sword<WH02719>, the famine<WH07458>, and the pestilence<WH01698>, among them, till they be consumed<WH08552><WTH8800> from off the land<WH0127> that I gave<WH05414><WTH8804> unto them and to their fathers<WH01>.<CM>
